case_title: Parvati Devi v. The State of Bihar Now State of Jharkhand & Ors.
aggravating_circumstances: Dowry demands, harassment, abnormal death circumstances
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under s.304B and s.201 r/w s.34
neutral_facts: The accused, who were the husband and in-laws of the deceased, subjected the victim to harassment and demands for dowry shortly after her marriage. The victim disappeared from her matrimonial home, and her body was later found in a river. The prosecution relied on circumstantial evidence, including witness testimonies about the harassment and the victim's disappearance. The trial court convicted all accused under the Dowry Prohibition Act and IPC sections related to dowry death. The High Court upheld the conviction, and the Supreme Court confirmed the conviction of the husband but acquitted the mother-in-law due to insufficient evidence against her.
